fullDescription: A high-performance 'Cyber-Marine' style guide optimized for disaster management, SaaS dashboards, and technical intelligence platforms. Featuring a dark-mode aesthetic with electric cyan accents (#38bdf8), glassmorphism (24px blur), and a cinematic information hierarchy. The design utilizes a mix of 'Space Grotesk' for brutalist headers and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for clean data readability. Key features include scroll-snap transitions, circular reveal masks, bit-allocation visualization bars, and color-coded status 'verdict' cards (Emerald, Amber, Red). Perfect for data-heavy applications requiring high-trust, technical sophistication, and rapid decision-making workflows.
prompt:
## Resumo
The Foreshore style is a cinematic, technical design system built on a deep #0a0a0b foundation. It uses a high-contrast 'Electric Cyan' accent to guide the eye through dense data. The interface prioritizes 'Reasoning vs. Action' through clear visual verdicts and technical provenance grids. It combines brutalist typography (7xl to 12xl headers) with delicate glass containers and WebGL-driven motion backgrounds for an 'elite-tech' feel.

## Estilo Visual
### Core Aesthetic
- **Base Background:** Deep charcoal-black (#0a0a0b).
- **Primary Accent:** Electric Cyan (#38bdf8) used for icons, interactive borders, and text glows.
- **Typography:** 
  - Headings: 'Space Grotesk', bold weights (700), tracking -0.05em, leading 0.8 to 0.9 for ultra-large sizes.
  - Body/Data: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', medium (500) and light (300) weights.
  - Monospace/Caps: All-caps technical labels at 10px, 0.4em letter spacing.
- **Glassmorphism Spec:** Background rgba(18, 18, 20, 0.65), backdrop-filter: blur(24px), border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5).
- **Motion:** WebGL lightning/noise backgrounds, ease-out-cubic reveal transitions, and circular clip-path reveal masks (0% to 150% radius).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation & Sidebar
Fixed top bar, height 80px, background #0a0a0b. Left: Logo with icon and dual-stack text (Title 24px, Subtitle 8px with 0.5em spacing). Center: Tiny all-caps links (10px) with 2px cyan underline hover animations. Right: Primary CTA in #38bdf8 with rounded-full pill shape. Right-side fixed vertical scroll indicator using 6px dots that expand to 32px height when active.

### Hero Section
Center-aligned, 100vh. Headline: 11rem 'Space Grotesk' bold, leading 0.8, text-shadow glow #38bdf8. Sub-headline: 2xl light-weight text with a bold cyan emphasis. CTA buttons: Large (px-16, py-6), one solid white with 50px shadow, one outlined border-white/20. Background features a WebGL noise/lightning shader in cyan hues.

### Stats Grid (The Problem)
2-column layout. Left: Section title 8xl with 0.9 leading. Right: Narrative text at 2xl. Bottom: 2x2 grid of glass cards. Each card has an 8px left accent border (alternating red/cyan/gray), 7xl bold numeric values, and 10px bold uppercase labels.

### Verdict Cards (The Solution)
3-column horizontal grid. Glass cards with 8px top borders color-coded to status (#10b981, #f59e0b, #ef4444). Top right of card: Large all-caps status text. Bottom: Italicized description in line-height 1.8. Cards should have hover-glow effects corresponding to their status color.

### Pipeline/Flow Diagram
Horizontal sequence of 8 glass-card modules (min-width 140px). Connected by a subtle horizontal 1px line. Each module: Icon (3xl cyan), Stage Label (9px uppercase), and Stage Name (12px bold). Underneath: A 5-column grid of 'Specialist' cards with large 5xl icons and technical data descriptions.

### Bit Allocation Chart (Innovation)
A visual data bar, height 48px, 1px border white/10. Segmented proportionally by bit-count. Active payload segment (220 bits) highlighted in #38bdf8 with internal inner-shadow. Labels for each segment (TLM, TOWC, RSVD) at 9px bold.

### Footer & Attribution
Large spacing (mt-40). 3-column link structure. Left: Brand block with 11px uppercase metadata. Center: Resource links in tiny uppercase tracking. Right: Theme/Problem statement attribution in italic cyan 10px text. Divider line: 1px white/5.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Decision Payload Bar — A horizontal bar chart representing bitwise data allocation.
Create a flex container 'bit-bar' with 48px height and 8px border-radius. Use background white/5 and border white/10. Inside, create 'bit-segment' divs with width percentages corresponding to bit sizes. The central 'Decision Payload' segment must be #38bdf8 with a #0a0a0b text color and an electric glow (box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(56,189,248,0.4)).

### Scroll-Indicator Dots — Dynamic vertical navigation progress indicator.
Position fixed, right 2.5rem, top 50%. Flex column with 1.25rem gap. Dots are 6px circle, background white/20. Active dot transforms into 32px height pill, background #38bdf8, border-radius 6px, with cyan glow shadow.

style.description: Cyber-industrial dark mode with a focus on marine intelligence. Typography uses Space Grotesk for high-impact titles (tight letter spacing, negative leading) and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text. The color palette is strictly #0a0a0b (background), #F9F9F9 (text), and #38bdf8 (primary accent), with semantic statuses in Emerald (#10b981), Amber (#f59e0b), and Red (#ef4444). Components feature glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, 1px white/5 borders) and subtle glow effects (box-shadow/text-shadow).
